claims.scope: Every finite k-selector among parity branches whose 2^k data supports form an antichain, with arbitrary common character and unbounded physical-coordinate reuse.
claims.statement: G=k/2-2^{-k} sum_{i,z} log2 d_i(z), I=|C|+k/2+2^{-k}sum_z|A_z|, hence G<=I with no dimension, arity, overlap, or congestion loss.
claims.universal_consequence: All coherent overlap created by restricting antichain character branches is an exact nonpositive signed refund; this mechanism cannot obstruct universal GU.
